Founded in 1968, Bull Stockwell Allen is a San Francisco architecture firm with a sister office in Boston. For over five decades, it has led in resort, recreation, and hospitality design, specializing in mountain day lodges and ski resorts. Beyond traditional architecture, it offers concepting, feasibility studies, and visualization. Its specialized mountain resort expertise helps it handle the complex demands of seasonal, climate-driven projects. The firm has earned more than 78 major design honors, including "Firm of the Year" from the AIA California Council and a Presidential Design Award. Its philosophy centers on environmental responsibility, contextual awareness, design honesty, and exceptional client communication and service.
Role Description:
As a Project Architect, you will bring an independent spirit and a creative approach to problem-solving. The ideal candidate possesses excellent communication skills and the ability to effectively coordinate internal team members and external consultants/clients throughout various project phases. This role will be responsible for the design and implementation of architectural projects from concept design through construction. Project Architects at BSA are responsible for the health and organization of the Revit model and committed to delivering exceptional service, ensuring quality outcomes, and building lasting client relationships.
Responsibilities & Core Competencies:
Project Leadership: Act as the leader on projects and pilot project teams throughout all phases. This includes:
Client Service: Provide personalized service to clients, ensuring their needs and expectations are met.
Strategic Planning: Develop and implement project plans, including scheduling, budget, and staffing considerations.
Expectation Management: Manage project expectations regarding budgets, staffing, and schedules with support from senior staff.
Leadership Development: Demonstrate leadership outside of project work by fostering a collaborative and inclusive work environment.
Design: Direct the design on architectural, planning, and prospective project proposals in collaboration with design principals.
Qualifications & Required Skills:
Experience: Minimum of 8 years within the architecture profession, preferably with experience in Hospitality.
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Architecture from an accredited institution.
Licensure: Licensed Architect in the United States.
Technical Proficiency: Strong proficiency in Revit is essential.
Design Skills: Excellent design and presentation skills.
Project Management: Proven project management experience, including managing budgets, staffing, and project plans.
Communication Skills: Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills (verbal, written, and graphic).
Mentorship: A desire to mentor and foster a positive and inclusive work environment.
Technical Knowledge: Working knowledge of building systems and the ability to visualize building design from concept to construction.
This position is full time, with full Healthcare, Vision, and Dental coverage, 401(k), Pre-Tax Flexible Spending Account, Commuter Benefits, Hybrid Work Schedule, and generous PTO including paid holidays. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer.
If interested, please submit your CV and portfolio of work to [email protected] with Project Architect and or Project Manager in your subject heading.
